title: Video: Severe flooding closes schools in Saudi Arabia
description: Saudi Arabia has ordered schools to close after severe flooding swept through parts of the country.
content:
NewsFeed
Saudi Arabia has ordered schools to close after severe flooding swept through parts of the country. Heavy rain swamped roads around Riyadh and in the Al Ahsa governorate.
de: Video: Schwere Überschwemmungen schließen Schulen in Saudi-Arabien. Saudi-Arabien hat die Schließung von Schulen angeordnet, nachdem schwere Überschwemmungen Teile des Landes heimgesucht haben.
en: Video: Severe flooding closes schools in Saudi Arabia. Saudi Arabia has ordered schools to close after severe flooding swept through parts of the country.
la: Video: Gravis inundatio scholas claudit in Arabia Saudiana. Arabia Saudiana scholas claudere iussit, postquam gravis inundatio per partes nationis transiit.
